requirement:
修复用户信息修改功能的 bug。
用户修改个人信息后，认证服务没有同步更新。
需要检查用户服务和认证服务之间的数据同步逻辑。

details.name: ts-auth-service
details.rationale: The requirement explicitly states the authentication service is not syncing after user profile updates, so it must be updated to receive or fetch the changes.

details.name: ts-admin-user-service
details.rationale: Admin user management may also modify user data and could be affected by the same sync issue, though the primary flow is user-service to auth-service.

details.name: ts-gateway-service
details.rationale: The gateway routes requests between services and may need configuration or routing changes if the sync API endpoints change.
